combo_label: Sleep & Dreams × Deserts × Alice in Wonderland

entries.clue: Sleep rough or bed down anywhere; also, to laze about doing nothing
Square dance along the sea-shore, begun once the jellyfish are cleared away
Foam stoppers, squeezed thin and pushed in, that mute a rumbling neighbour
Chilean plateau reckoned the driest place on Earth outside the poles
The world's largest hot desert, sprawling across northern Africa
Long-eared tea-table host whose springtime madness is proverbial
Milliner for whom it is always six o'clock and always time for tea
So dry that scarcely a root can take hold
Feather-fronded tree whose bunched fruit is dried and sold as dates
Long, sad story the Mouse relates, laid out on the page as a winding curve
Short sleep in the afternoon; also the raised pile on velvet
Thin fold of skin, fringed with lashes, that closes as you drop off
